name: 红丝绒
evolution: 治愈兔 → 红丝绒 Lv.16 → 红绒十字 Lv.36
description: 绒毛里储存着温和的火系能量，抱在怀里就像一个小暖炉，身体散发出煎药的香味。它特别喜欢照顾受伤的精灵，会用温暖的鼻息轻轻吹拂伤口，伤口就不痛了。
descriptionEn: Its fur stores gentle Fire-type energy; held in one's arms it is like a little warmer, and its body gives off the scent of boiled medicine. It especially likes to care for wounded spirits, gently blowing on wounds with its warm breath so the pain goes away.
